{{Top|leg}}
'''Ryyts''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau's]] [[Bank of Aargau Security, Ltd.]], a subsidiary of the [[Bank of Aargau/Legends|Bank of Aargau]] in charge of planetary defense. Ryyts worked at [[Planetary Customs Security Checkpoint LH48]] and was eventually replaced by Captain [[Smalyun]].<ref name="aargau">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030807aargau|text=Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs|int=Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs}}}}</ref>
